abab.method: Per-boot medians from each stage's 03/11 L.A.I.L logs (ms/step = median of decode_s/chunks) and 04-bench-decode SUMMARY. noise = max(B1-B2 spread, C1-C2 spread) (ARMS.md step 6). Promote-side test: C-vs-B median improvement > noise AND every C boot beats the B median. Caveat: B1 ran canonical-e12 without WILLNEED/STREAM_FEED; B2/C1/C2 are e13 with them.

decisions.DSV41_WOA_PREPACK: promote: bit-exact (s1 BITWISE PASS; 43/43 per-layer bitwise self-test on both ranks in C1 and C2, 0 REJECTED); kernel faster (s1 31.75->25.0 us/call at M=3; s5 trace -0.71/-0.81 ms/step on r0/r1); ABAB bundle not worse beyond B1-B2 spread on any perf metric (prose c1 ms/step -0.60 vs noise 0.27). decisions.DSV41_MHC_DECODE_SPLITS: reject (stay 0): not bit-exact (fp32 reorder, maxabs 6e-6); quality quick did not pass in both C boots (C1 FAIL aa_hazard 0.03409 > 0.03206; C2 PASS 0.02204).
